title: This group is ran by anti aiers
author: Monecreiff
selftext: This group was secretly created by people who are strongly opposed to artificial intelligence, with the intention of targeting, mocking, and publicly criticizing video games developed with the assistance of AI. I'm writing this from an alternate account because I'm personally involved with some of the individuals responsible for creating this Reddit community. I was initially against the use of AI in game development myself, but what started as criticism has escalated into something far more concerning. The people behind this community have also established a private Discord server where members organize discussions specifically to ridicule and target games that use AI, along with the developers behind them. I believe there is a difference between having legitimate concerns about AI in the gaming industry and deliberately organizing groups to attack independent creators simply because they choose to use these tools. What I've witnessed has crossed that line, and I no longer feel comfortable remaining silent about it
